about: Senses of the external (Wiktionary) dictionary that the reader never shows, beyond the automatic names rule (fallback-dictionary.js: a word with a personal name hides its labelled slang / rude noun senses — Johannes, Petrus, Fritz, Kalle, Jürgen, Bimbo …). Each row: spelling, sense id, the exact English gloss (the row applies only while the gloss still matches), reason. The dictionary files themselves are not edited. ru_entries: parts of a Russian translation (word, part of speech, the exact part between «;») that are never shown.
